north_star: Build an empirically anchored artificial electoral society that improves real-time understanding of Morocco 2026, then test whether agent dynamics add out-of-sample value beyond structural baselines.
primary_goal: Decode the 2026 Moroccan parliamentary election by identifying which observed political mechanisms matter electorally, where they matter territorially, and whether they can alter turnout, party choice, local seat cutoffs, or coalition structure.
secondary_goal: Test whether a calibrated artificial society and bounded LLM cognition add stable, falsifiable, out-of-sample explanatory or predictive value beyond structural and statistical baselines.
non_goals: maximizing UI polish as a project milestone
producing a national seat forecast before validation gates pass
tuning synthetic parameters until dramatic political effects appear
treating LLM narrative richness as evidence

phase_map.exit_gate: electoral rules, source provenance, allocator and protocol are auditable
territorial replay, seat margins, candidates, events and evidence graph are sufficiently complete for held-out testing
A/B/C0/C experiment is calibrated, causal ablations are valid, and synthetic network effects are measured rather than narrated
Model D is replayable, stable across model/prompt variants, and either beats B/C on frozen holdout or is killed
92 local + 12 regional coverage, live event ingestion, calibrated seat-risk map, and prospective decoding operate without retrospective tuning
pre-election freeze is complete and 23 September results are scored against all frozen models with an unrevised postmortem

retain_only_if: prompt and model instability are below claimed incremental effect
out-of-sample score improves versus both B and C on the frozen holdout

anti_drift_questions: Which north-star question does this work answer?
What new falsifiable claim becomes testable?
Which phase exit gate does it advance?
What evidence level is added: observed, derived, synthetic-calibrated, synthetic-sensitivity, or LLM-derived?
What result would cause us to kill or reverse this work?
Could the same effort instead improve real Morocco-2026 understanding more directly?
Does this accidentally promote a synthetic assumption into an observed fact?
Does this unlock a forecast? If yes, are all forecast gates actually satisfied?
